programme.title: Rolls-Royce Wraith
programme.desc: The Rolls Royce Wraith is different. It gives the traditional British brand a whole new dynamic.

programme.title: Classic Ride

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: The Ducati 1198 S, a factory bike that makes you feel like a racing sports star. Also: the naked bike Ducati Streetfighter feels both comfortable on the race track and in the urban jungle. And: pro racer Andy Meklau on a Suzuki GSX-R 600.

programme.title: Motorcycles

programme.desc: KTM Superduke versus Honda’s new contender, the CB1000R. Also: globetrotter Astrid take her BMW F 800 GS to Africa. And: Aprilia's Shiver SL 750 and Mana NA 850. The two V2's are supposed to keep the competition on their toes.

programme.desc: Kati from Munich is a big fan of US cars. She and her boyfriend fulfilled their dreams by buying a 1972 Chevy Chevelle that was found and imported directly from the USA by Frank Slopianka and his company Special Cars Berlin.
